hints.title: Subarray Condition
hints.text: Semi-repeating means having at most one index where adjacent numbers are identical.

hints.title: Sliding Range Expansion
hints.text: Expand the right boundary while keeping count of adjacent equal pairs in the active range.

hints.title: Left Boundary Contraction
hints.text: Contract the left boundary whenever the count of adjacent duplicate pairs exceeds one.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Each index is visited at most twice by the expanding and contracting window pointers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking every candidate subarray takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracks window counts using two integer pointers in O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Implement two pointers cleanly maintaining adjacent duplicate counts.
